title: Stripe API degradation caused 87% payment failure rate for 6 minutes
description: Stripe API outage 17:58–18:04 UTC caused ApiConnectionException timeouts on all /v1/charges calls. payment-svc circuit breaker was not implemented — every request waited 30s before failing. 847 transactions queued. Post-incident: added Resilience4j circuit breaker (commit c4d5e6f7) with queue-based fallback. Zero transactions lost.

title: Implement retry budget and exponential backoff for all third-party API calls
description: Extend circuit breaker pattern to all third-party integrations (Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid). Add retry budget per service. Publish runbook for third-party API degradation.
